Add Music 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Supports upload, background music editing, timeline text overlays, and 1080p MP4 export.
- Status, credits, and export functions available via simple commands.
- Fast processing (20–40 seconds typical), with progress and error feedback.
- Detailed mapping of user prompts to actions for intuitive workflows.
